history.sg_progress: The strengthening of performance measures has been carried out in the biennium 2018–2019; after being recommended by the Board in its report, it was recommended to the General Assembly by the Committee for Programme and Coordination in its report on its fifty-fifth session (A/70/16) and adopted by the Assembly in its resolution 70/8. Going forward, as part of the new budget cycle and format that were approved by the Assembly in its resolution 72/266 A, the new format for the presentation of programme plans will be different. The Secretariat is working with all departments in 2018 to operationalize the decisions on budget reform contained in resolution 72/266 A. The programme budget for 2020 will reflect the results-based frameworks accordingly.
